{{Quote|Well, thanks to the Yuuzhan Vong, the Firrerreos are now a dead species. And the Belderonians won't be far behind.|A [[Unidentified Ryn|member]] of the [[Ryn Network]]|<ref name="Remnant">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>}}
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the Yuuzhan Vong '''conquered''' the [[Belderone system/Legends|Belderone system]].
